title: Polymorphous' Reel #1
author: Christine Hale
problems: Row 4 "star left 3 places to partner" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
The progression after row 3 "with neighbor, slide along set to shadows" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 4 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).

figures.text: neighbors take inside hands, star through to a ring
with neighbor, slide along set to shadows
